g.text: A platform workflow need not be a Kubernetes CRD.
Service identity stays a service unless delegation is known.
[Candidate is consistent and from an accepted source]
C. React to change without repeated owner walks
Owner changes, recreation and watch recovery still invalidate state.
Status-only updates need not rerun identity evaluation.
D. Expose the result and its limits
Blue: submission / Green: observation / Gray: local decisions
Illustrative proposal; CEL and canonical stamping are not deployed.
